name: Ploutoz live-reserve collateral pricing
summary: Ploutoz, a bZx-style lending fork, priced DOP collateral with a PancakeOracle that returned the spot reserve ratio of a DOP/BUSD pair. The attacker flash-swapped BUSD, bought DOP to inflate that ratio, borrowed from six iToken pools against a small DOP deposit and sold the DOP back; a copycat and the attacker repeated it later.
notes: The PancakeOracle was harmless until PriceFeeds mapped DOP to it (pricesFeeds[DOP], slot 4); that oracle wiring, a HIGH price-source config, is the latest change the exploit needed. Later protocol and iToken storage changes are loan accounting.

Campaign: every Borrow with DOP collateral (protocol event 0xfb6c38ae, topic2 = DOP) from the oracle wiring onwards; all eight are in the anchor or these two flash-swap txs (one by a copycat, one by the attacker).

Loss is depletion of the iToken pools and protocol together, so lending fees cancel. DefiLlama has no DOLLY price; it is valued at the BUSD the attacker realised selling it, and BUSD at the Binance USD market price.
